task.title: Raise ValueError when a CSV has no data rows
task.description: Reject a header-only CSV with a descriptive error while preserving existing missing-column and numeric-column validation.
requirements: If all requested columns exist but the CSV contains no data rows, raise ValueError before numeric-type validation.
The ValueError message must clearly state that the CSV contains no data rows.
Keep missing-column validation first so an absent requested column still produces the existing missing-column error.
Preserve the existing behavior for populated numeric and non-numeric selected columns.
Add meaningful pytest coverage for a header-only CSV and for missing-column precedence on an empty CSV.
Do not change the command-line interface or unrelated plotting behavior.
acceptance_criteria: A header-only CSV containing both requested columns raises ValueError mentioning that it has no data rows.
A header-only CSV missing a requested column still raises the existing missing-column ValueError.
Populated numeric columns continue to return their values unchanged.
